messages:
Marcos: FYI ACME SI reported small set of customers where carryover credits disappeared after hourly rollups. They sent a sample event that landed exactly on the boundary and we seem to drop it. Example payload: 

Marcos: ```json
{
  "device_id": "edge-42",
  "timestamp": 1686720000,   // exactly on the hour
  "usage_units": 0,
  "event_type": "heartbeat"
}
```

Alice: Is this tied to DST cutover or just general boundary behavior? Any repro from partner?

Dan: Repro'd locally. Our rollup groups by floor(ts / 3600) and we run a post-filter that drops usage==0 events as "no-op". That means presence-only heartbeats at boundary vanish and entitlement markers never get written.

Priya: If markers don't exist, billing sees fewer active devices -> under-credit risk. Finance wants an impact estimate and a backfill plan.

Mei: Running a quick query for usage_units=0 and ts % 3600 == 0 scoped to hardware partners last 30d. Will post counts in a minute.

Marcos: Proposed approach: 1) Treat zero-usage heartbeat within a configurable grace window as a presence marker (suggest 15m), 2) Backfill missing ledger markers for last 30d, 3) Give partner reconciliation CSV + comms template, 4) Add metrics/tests.

Dan: Implementation note: keep zero-usage events if event_type==heartbeat OR if there are no non-zero events in that aggregation key/window. For safety, tag backfilled markers with origin="grace-fix" to avoid double-counting on replays. I'll prepare a PR with unit + integration tests.

Alice: I'll review. Add metrics: metering.grace_preserved, metering.grace_backfilled, metering.grace_ambiguous. Also request infra canary for an hour.

Priya: Finance needs CSV: account_id, meter_key, window_start_iso, missing_marker_bool, estimated_credits_usd. If >200 accounts hit, limit auto-crediting and escalate manual review.

Mei: Dry-run counts: found 142 unique account_ids in last 30d matching the pattern. Sharing query link (internal): http://links.internal/query/1749128888 (placeholder).

PartnerBot: Support ticket created: ACME-987. Partner notified; requested raw event batches for the 30d window.

Marcos: Action items: Dan -> PR today, tag @Alice for review; Alice -> review + canary dashboard; Mei -> run backfill dry-run and export ambiguous rows; Priya -> draft finance CSV and comms; Marcos -> schedule 30m sync with ACME SI tomorrow. Legal loop if credit policy changes.

Alice: :thumbsup:

Priya: Comms draft by noon. Will include USD impact estimate.

Dan: PR opened: https://git.re/redwood/ingest/pull/1299

Mei: Backfill dry-run done: 138/142 rows matched cleanly; 4 ambiguous entries missing device_id/correlator, need partner-side resolution. Exported to /tmp/acme_ambiguous_1749128888.csv and shared with Marcos.

Marcos: We'll hand ambiguous rows to the ACME SI as part of the sync. Plan to ship behind feature flag, monitor for 24h canary, then flip. We'll also include a small reconcile tool for partner to run locally. Any objections?

Alice: No objections. I'll create canary dashboard panels (latency, preserved_count, backfill_rate).

Priya: Noted. I'll prepare the CSV template and the partner-facing explanation.

Dan: Updating PR with origin tag and tests now.

Marcos: Thanks all for the quick turn. Closing thread unless anything else comes up.
